text: On 18 May 2023 Evan said he had just returned from a family trip to the Rockies in his new Prius, and he shared a photo of a lake with rocks and mountains in the background.
Evan said his old Prius broke down, so he had it repaired and then decided to sell it, and he bought the new Prius shortly before the Rockies trip.
Evan and his family hiked the trails in the Rockies during the week of 8 May 2023, and Evan said the views were amazing.
Sam said he did a long hike with his dad when he was ten years old, which was quite a feat for him then and a special memory for them both.
Sam said on 18 May 2023 that he had no hobbies yet, that he has not done much hiking for ages, and that he was thinking about trying painting.
Evan said he has been doing watercolour painting for a few years, that it is a great stress-buster, and that a friend got him into it and gave him advice, after which he was hooked right away.
Evan shared a photo of his watercolour painting of a cactus in the desert, and Sam called it impressive and asked how Evan got into watercolour painting.
Evan encouraged Sam to keep trying new things until something sparks his excitement, and Sam said he hoped to find a passion as strong as Evan's for watercolour painting.
Evan and Sam agreed to catch up soon, and Sam said he would keep Evan posted on how he was enjoying his new hobbies.

Evan took his family on a road trip to Jasper during the weekend of 13 to 14 May 2023, driving the Icefields Parkway past glaciers and lakes, and he shared a photo of a glacier he photographed on the trip.
Evan described the Jasper road trip as a real retreat, with fresh air, peacefulness, and a cozy cabin surrounded by mountains and forests.
On 24 May 2023 Sam said his week had been tough, and that a check-up with his doctor a few days earlier showed his weight was not great, which he found pretty eye-opening.
Sam asked Evan for tips on starting to break old habits, and Evan recommended finding a fitness routine he really enjoys and making small, smarter diet choices that add up over time.

Sam said he had been thinking about painting to stay motivated and de-stress, and Evan replied that painting relieves stress and builds creativity but would not solve Sam's weight problem, so Evan recommended exercising as well.
Evan said on 24 May 2023 that he had been painting for a few years and that painting helps him find peace.
Evan said he had a health scare in the week of 29 May 2023, a sudden heart palpitation incident that really shook him up and was a serious wake-up call about his lifestyle.
Sam said on 6 June 2023 that he was trying to eat healthier, but admitted he had made no diet changes yet and was still enjoying soda and candy, which he knew was not the best habit.
Evan said he was trying to eat less processed food and sugary snacks, even though he loves ginger snaps, and he asked Sam whether Sam had made any diet changes recently.
Evan suggested Sam swap soda for flavoured seltzer water and swap candy for dark chocolate with high cocoa content, and Sam replied that it was a good idea and he would give it a try.

Evan said exercise clears the mind and shared a photo of a bearded man holding a dumbbell, and Sam asked Evan to help him get started, so Evan offered to get together and show Sam some basic exercises.
On 6 June 2023 Sam said he was coming from the shop, where all the self-checkout machines at the supermarket were broken, and that the frustration had put him in a terrible mood.
Sam said his friends had mocked his weight on Friday 21 July 2023, that it hurt him, and that it made him realise he needed to make changes to his health.

Evan said he had struggled with his health a few years earlier but stuck with it, and he shared a photo of his gym membership card as a reminder of his commitment, adding that diet and lifestyle changes also play a big role.
Evan said he made dietary changes, cutting down on sugary snacks and eating more vegetables and fruit, and that these changes made a big impact on his health.
On 27 July 2023 Sam said he was reducing his intake of soda and candy, which was tough, but he was determined to make a change.
Evan recommended flavoured seltzer water as a great alternative to soda, and suggested pairing it with air-popped popcorn or fruit as healthy, low-calorie snacks.
Evan said he could not stop thinking about the mystery novel he was reading, which he named as The Great Gatsby, and Sam said he would definitely read that novel sometime.

Evan asked whether Sam had thought about exercising, saying it is just as important as eating right, and Sam replied that he would start going to the gym and exercising regularly starting tomorrow, 28 July 2023.
Evan said that in the week of 31 July 2023 he went on a trip to Canada and met an incredible Canadian woman, and that being with her made him feel alive and was like something out of a movie.
On 7 August 2023 Evan said he had been working on his healthy lifestyle for two years, with ups and downs, and that dealing with recent health issues had made him appreciate the good moments more.
Evan said his family motivates him to stay healthy, and that the smartwatch he wears tracks his progress well and serves as a constant reminder to keep going, which he found really motivating.
On 7 August 2023 Sam said he was thinking of ordering a smartwatch like Evan's, and asked whether they were worth it and what else motivates Evan.
Evan said he is motivated by a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes, and he shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water.
Evan said he has a bonsai tree in a black vase, which he bought because it symbolises strength and resilience, and that taking care of it motivates him to keep going through tough times.
On 7 August 2023 Evan said ginger snaps are his weakness, and he said his kids bring him a lot of joy as he shared a photo of a woman and a child on a swing set.
Evan said on 13 August 2023 that he had just returned from a rad vacation in Canada with his new partner, where they tried hiking and biking and loved exploring the outdoors together.
On 13 August 2023 Sam said things had been challenging lately and that some stuff had been hard on his health, and Evan offered to help in any way he could.
Sam said on 13 August 2023 that Evan's support meant a lot to him, and that a note he had been keeping held a quote reminding him that progress is more important than perfection.
The quote Sam shared from his note reads: Don't fear it, just take the first step. It has been helping him move forward to healthier habits.
Sam said taking small steps towards a healthier life is still progress, and Evan said he agreed with that mindset and that it helps him too.
On 13 August 2023 Evan said he had been searching for his keys for the last half hour with no luck, and that he loses his keys every week.
Sam said he had an amazing dream the night before 13 August 2023 in which he was soaring over skyscrapers, and he wondered what the dream signified.
Evan suggested Sam check out a dream interpretation book for insights into the skyscraper dream, and Sam said he would look into it.
Evan said his son had a soccer accident on Saturday 12 August 2023 and hurt his ankle, and that Evan had been looking after him and taking him to the doctor.

Sam said on 15 August 2023 that he had a tough week and a doctor's appointment, which was a wake-up call to take better care of himself, and that he was taking a cooking class to learn how to make healthier meals.

Sam said the cooking class had taught him awesome recipes, and that on the night of 14 August 2023 he made a grilled salmon and vegetable dish, marinated with a few different ingredients, which turned out really flavourful.
Evan said on 15 August 2023 that he wanted to eat healthy and add more vegetables to his meals, and asked Sam for recipes, and Sam offered to share a tasty and easy roasted vegetable recipe.
Evan said his son's ankle was getting better but was still sore, and that it was rough at first but thank goodness it was nothing serious.
On 15 August 2023 Sam said he had been feeling a mix of emotions, somewhat concerned about his health but also motivated to make positive changes, and was taking things one step at a time.
Sam said on 19 August 2023 that he was on a diet and living healthier, that it had been tough but he was determined, and he shared a photo of a bowl of spinach, avocado, and strawberries.
Sam said on 19 August 2023 that he had noticed positive changes on his diet, including more energy and less sluggishness after eating, which he found really encouraging.
Sam shared a recipe for a flavourful and healthy grilled chicken and veggie stir-fry with his homemade sauce, and sent Evan the recipe card on 19 August 2023, and Evan said he would give it a shot.

Evan said that a few days before 19 August 2023 he had started painting classes, where they have been learning about watercolours, and the instructor stresses observing nature and painting what you see.
Evan said a friend gave him a painting one day that inspired him to start painting, and that he joined the classes to find like-minded people and show them what he can do.
Evan said he has been painting with brushes, pencils and eyeliners for now and might look into other classes, and that painting is awesome for finding his peace and expressing himself.
Evan said he loves painting landscapes because nature's beauty captivates him and brings him peace, and he aims to capture the vibe of nature and the peacefulness of being outdoors in his paintings.

Evan said he loves being in places like forests because they bring back memories of road tripping in his trusty car, and that he drove somewhere fun last month (July 2023) where the views were amazing.

Evan said he skied in Banff, that the snow was amazing and he had a lot of fun, and he hopes to go back next year, adding that skiing, snowboarding and ice skating are the winter activities he enjoys.
On 19 August 2023 Sam said he would love to try skiing but was not sure his body could take it, and he said he wished he could join Evan in the winter fun.
Sam said on 27 August 2023 that he started a new diet and exercise routine on Monday 21 August 2023, which had made a huge difference, and that he felt great.
Evan said he twisted his knee on Friday 25 August 2023, that it was really painful, and that it was frustrating because staying active was mega-important to him.
Evan said on 27 August 2023 that he was waiting for a physical therapy appointment for his knee, and in the meantime he was keeping it low-key and swimming to stay active.
Sam suggested Evan look into low-impact exercises or physical therapy, and then said swimming was a good choice because it is low-impact, easy on the joints, and refreshing.
Evan said he took a road trip up to the Rocky Mountains in July 2023, and that the scenery was stunning, the views were amazing, and he felt so relaxed on the trip.

Sam said on 27 August 2023 that he had not been on a road trip in ages but loved being surrounded by nature, and that he hoped a road trip and a hike would be possible soon as he works on becoming healthier.
Evan recommended a lake that is a two-hour drive away, which he said has gorgeous views and lots of trails nearby, and suggested the two of them do a hike there together sometime.
On 27 August 2023 Sam said he would go check out the lake Evan recommended as a day trip to explore some of the local trails.
Evan said on 27 August 2023 that the book he had been talking about gets better with every page and that he cannot put it down, and Sam said the book had got him interested.
On 11 September 2023 Evan said the past few weeks had been about painting, and he shared a photo of his painting of a sunset over a body of water.
Sam said on 11 September 2023 that he had posted a before-and-after photo of his body to show the results of his diet, and that he was working to motivate others to make better choices.
Sam said he still has occasional cravings for sugary drinks and snacks, which is a real struggle, and that these cravings are usually set off by stress, boredom, or wanting comfort.

Evan said that when he is stressed he turns to something comforting, but he has found that painting or going for a drive helps too, and he shared a photo of his painting of a mountain range with a horse.
Sam said he wanted to give painting a go to de-stress, and Evan offered to help him get started, recommend supplies, and plan a painting session.
Evan suggested Sam get basic painting supplies: acrylic paints, brushes, a canvas or paper, and a palette for mixing colours, and offered to recommend specific items.
Evan and Sam planned a painting session for next Saturday, 16 September 2023, with Evan helping Sam pick out the supplies, and both said they were excited.
On 6 October 2023 Sam said he had started eating healthier and asked Evan what was new and whether he had picked up any new hobbies, sharing a photo of a bowl of fruit with a striped cloth.
Evan said he had a knee setback in the week of 25 September 2023 after messing it up playing basketball with the kids, and that it had been tough to stay active since, which he really missed.

Evan said physical therapy had helped his knee, that he cannot do intense workouts, and that he does easy exercises to keep the knee strong, which is not as good as being active outdoors but still something.

Evan said that about two weeks before 6 October 2023, in late September 2023, he helped a lost tourist find their way and ended up taking an unexpected tour around the city with them, which he said was a blast.
Evan said watercolour painting is a great stress reliever and that he painted a cactus picture in the week before 6 October 2023, which he shared with Sam.
Evan said his sunset painting was inspired by a vacation a few years earlier, and that his cactus painting came from a road trip he took in September 2023.

Evan said he usually paints what is on his mind or what he is feeling, such as good memories or places he wants to go, and that painting is a way for him to express himself and his emotions without words.

Sam said on 6 October 2023 that he is still learning to draw but loves expressing himself through writing, especially journaling and creative writing, which he finds therapeutic and which helps him sort out his feelings.
Sam said his new phone's navigation app kept malfunctioning, which made getting around a challenge, and Evan recommended updating the phone because updating usually works for him.
Sam said he had a check-up on Monday 2 October 2023 and his doctor told him his weight was a serious health risk that could get worse if he did not make changes soon, which was really hitting him.
Sam admitted on 8 October 2023 that he had made jokes about his weight in the past, and said he had been having a hard time with the news from his doctor.

Evan said he started lifting weights one year earlier, around October 2022, that it was a struggle at first but he is now seeing some gains, and he asked Sam whether he would be interested in trying it.
Evan advised Sam to start with good form and technique, find a trainer to help avoid injuries, start with something small, and increase the intensity as he gets stronger.
Sam said on 8 October 2023 that he would find someone to help him out with weights and would keep Evan posted on his progress, and he thanked Evan for his support.
Evan told Sam that progress takes time, to be patient with himself, and to take one step at a time, and he shared a photo of a notepad with a note and a pair of scissors.

Sam said in the week before 14 October 2023 he gave in and bought some unhealthy snacks and felt guilty about it, while Evan said not to worry and shared that he had just finished a sunset painting that helps him relax.
Sam said on 14 October 2023 that he was dealing with work stress and trying to stay motivated, and Evan suggested picking up a hobby to help him de-stress.
Evan suggested kayaking as a fun and active way to paddle on a river or lake, and Sam said he had not tried it yet but was considering giving it a try.
On 14 October 2023 Sam said he and his mate were just around the corner from the lake and were going to try kayaking that day, and Evan offered to plan a kayaking trip together and pick a cool spot.
Sam said the group was travelling through Lake Tahoe, which he heard is great for kayaking, and Evan replied that Lake Tahoe is an awesome pick with clear water and gorgeous views.

Sam said he had a health scare the weekend of 14 to 15 October 2023, ending up in the ER with a severe stomachache that turned out to be gastritis, which was a wake-up call for him to prioritise his health.
Sam said on 17 October 2023 that he planned to prioritise his health through a more nutritious diet and regular exercise, and that his phone had been giving him a hard time and adding to his stress.

Evan said on 17 October 2023 that he had been focusing on fitness, which had been really beneficial for his overall well-being, and that he had been at the gym the day before, 16 October 2023, gaining strength.
Evan said he had recently had another encounter with a lost tourist, which he said seemed to be becoming a recurring theme in his life.
Evan advised Sam to set goals such as a certain distance to run or a number of push-ups, to find an exercise he enjoys, and to get a buddy for extra fun and accountability.
Sam said he would give the goal-setting and exercise-buddy advice a try, and he and Evan agreed to plan a hike together soon, which Sam said he was super excited about.
Sam said on 25 October 2023 that he had been trying to keep up with his new health routine but it was tough, and that his family was really pushing him for it, which made him feel pressured.
Evan said on 25 October 2023 that he had just got back from his morning walk, which really helps him start the day actively, and he advised Sam to take it slow and treat himself.
Sam said he sometimes gets impatient with himself when he wants results fast, and Evan replied that progress takes time, so Sam should take it one step at a time.

Evan said he went through a similar phase about two years earlier, changing his diet and starting to walk regularly, and he shared a photo of himself sitting at a table with lots of fruit and vegetables.
Evan said he changed by focusing on his well-being rather than fixating on quick results, and that letting go of unrealistic expectations was liberating both physically and mentally.
Evan advised Sam to take it one day at a time and celebrate small victories, and Sam said he wanted to feel the same sense of freedom and would focus on small wins.
Sam said on 9 November 2023 that he had become a Weight Watchers coach in his group, which was a big accomplishment that made him feel really proud.
Sam said being chosen as a coach was a great step in his quest for better health, and that being a coach will hopefully keep him motivated and help others stay committed too.
Evan said on 9 November 2023 that he had missed some events because of personal challenges since they last spoke, and he shared a photo of a guitar lying on the floor with a guitar strap.
Evan said his guitar is a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar, which he received as a gift from a close friend.
Evan said he lost his job in October 2023 when the company downsized and he was part of that, and that he is now job hunting, which has not been easy, though he is keeping his spirits up.

Evan said the sunset photo of himself on a beach with a surfboard was taken last Friday, 3 November 2023, at his favourite peaceful spot by the beach close to his home, where he goes to relax, unwind and find peace.
Evan and Sam agreed to visit Evan's favourite beach spot together, and Evan proposed planning the trip for next month, which is December 2023.

Evan said the week before 21 November 2023 he had a health scare and went to hospital after something suspicious was found during a check-up, but it turned out to be a misunderstanding and his doctors said everything is fine.
Evan said the health scare taught him the value of life and that he is now trying to enjoy the moment, and Sam said a health scare can make you re-evaluate what is important.
Sam said on 21 November 2023 that he had been dealing with some discomfort that was limiting his movement, and that he had been trying to make diet changes but it can be hard.
Sam said he got a book the day before, on 20 November 2023, which he calls his go-to feel-good flick, and he shared a photo of its cover showing a man.
Sam suggested that he and Evan make it a habit to appreciate something each day, and Evan agreed to take the time to appreciate the little things in life.
Evan said on 21 November 2023 that he stays in shape by hitting the gym and taking his car out for a spin, and Sam said his fitness goals have been hard to reach.
Evan said the small island in his photo is where he grew up and is his happy place, a place that shaped him and will always hold a special place in his heart.
Evan said on 5 December 2023 that his new Prius, which he had just bought, had broken down, which was a stressor because he relies on the car for his active lifestyle and road trips.
Evan said he was trying to see the Prius breakdown as a chance to explore other ways of staying active and travelling, and Sam said setbacks can sometimes lead to new opportunities.
Sam said he attended a Weight Watchers meeting on 4 December 2023 and learned some great tips there, and he shared a photo of a variety of bowls of fruit and yogurt.

Evan said he had been thinking about trying yoga for gentle stress relief and flexibility, and Sam said yoga had done wonders for his flexibility and stress levels and told Evan he should definitely try it.
Evan said he thought he would try yoga, and Sam asked Evan to let him know how the yoga goes.
Evan said on 9 December 2023 that his partner is pregnant and that they are excited, since it has been a while since they had a little one around the house.
Evan said he is excited and a bit nervous about the new baby, and that he still remembers the joy when his first child was born.
Evan shared a collage of his family's top memories, including birthdays, holidays and vacations, and said that a sign in the frame reads 'Bring it on Home', the family motto from their trip to Banff.
Evan said his family means the world to him, that they are his rock, and that he is looking forward to expanding the family and creating even more beautiful memories.
Evan said his family is planning a big family reunion next summer, which is summer 2024, and it will be a perfect opportunity to add to the collage, and Sam offered tips for organising it.
Evan said his son had an accident last Tuesday, 12 December 2023, when he fell off his bike, and that the son is doing better now, as Evan shared a photo of a young boy with crutches and a backpack.
Sam said on 17 December 2023 that he was doing okay after a few bumps, and that since they last talked he had been thinking about ways to cope with things, which had been challenging.
Sam said he used to love hiking but had not had the chance in a while, and Evan said he remembered and suggested they plan a hike soon.
Sam said on 17 December 2023 that he is struggling with his weight, which is affecting his confidence and motivation, and that he finds it tough to break out of his comfort zone.
Evan encouraged Sam to believe in himself, take it one day at a time, remember that his worth is not defined by his weight, and try something new even if it is only a small thing.

Evan shared a photo of a woman standing in front of a contemporary figurative painting he finished a few days before 17 December 2023, which he said emphasises emotional state through expressive brushwork and vibrant colour, and said he was very proud of it.
Evan said a close friend of his helped get that painting published in the exhibition, and Sam asked who the woman standing next to the painting was.
Evan said on 26 December 2023 that he got married the week before, in the week of 18 December 2023, to the woman from Canada, and he shared a photo of the bride and groom kissing in front of a tree.
Evan said he fell in love with his wife at first sight, which is why he believes in love at first sight, describing it as time stopping and a spark lighting up inside him.
Sam said on 26 December 2023 that he had started enjoying running in the mornings, which has been a great way to clear his head.
Evan shared a photo of a minimalist painting in blue, orange and black on a white background, which he said he made when he was feeling a mix of sad, mad and hopeful.
Evan said he painted a bird-over-painting piece with a sense of joy and freedom, using spontaneous strokes and bold colours to reflect a playful, liberated mood.
Sam said he went to an exhibit a few days before 26 December 2023 that inspired him, and he shared a photo of a woman holding flowers in front of her face.
Sam said he sketches occasionally but has not created anything remarkable yet, and Evan offered to help Sam get started if he ever wanted to give painting a go.
Evan said on 26 December 2023 that he had lost his keys again, which had become a weekly ritual for him, and Sam suggested a GPS sensor on his keys, which Evan said he would do once he found them.

Sam said on 31 December 2023 that he is really getting into a healthier lifestyle, and that he took his friends on an epic hiking trip on Friday 29 December 2023, sharing a photo of himself on a rock overlooking a valley.

Evan said he and his partner took the Prius on a long drive to the mountains during the weekend of 23 to 24 December 2023, and got into a little scrape on the way back, which was a minor accident with no serious harm.
Evan said the minor accident put a bit of a damper on telling his work friends about his marriage, though his work friends have been a great support to him.

Evan shared photos of healthy snacks he had been trying and said he would send Sam the recipes for some cookies he called awesome, and later shared a recipe he discovered for energy balls made from coconut and oats.
Sam said energy balls can be an acquired taste, and Evan said he enjoys them because they are energising and a healthy way to satisfy a sweet tooth.
Sam said on 31 December 2023 that he went to the store again and had issues with the self-checkout, which had become a regular annoyance for him, and joked that he seems to attract that problem.
Evan said on 31 December 2023 that he had never once had a problem with self-checkout, and Sam joked that Evan should call him at the store if Evan ever wanted to be in that situation.
Evan said on 5 January 2024 that he and his partner told their extended family about their marriage, which was so special and left them overwhelmed by the family's love and support.
Evan said their families are really happy for them about the marriage, which is the best part, and that he feels really lucky to have found someone who gets him.
Evan said on 6 January 2024 that he had started a new diet limiting himself to just two ginger snaps a day, and Sam said that was a great discipline.
On 6 January 2024 Evan said his family was having a get-together with homemade lasagna that night, and Sam said his own dinner was homemade lasagna too, kept light.
Sam shared a photo of a pie with raspberries and limes on top from his cousin's wedding, saying he did not make it but that it is a super special photo.

Evan said that next month, February 2024, he and his partner are heading to Canada for their honeymoon, and they plan to ski, try the local cuisine, and enjoy the beautiful snowy landscapes and views.
Evan said he planned to try poutine while in Canada and promised to let Sam know what he thought, and Sam said poutine is kind of a Canadian thing.
Evan said on 10 January 2024 that he went out with friends the night before, on 9 January 2024, drank too much, and had a pee accident near someone's roses, which he deeply regretted.
Evan said he apologised to the owners of the roses the next morning after he saw what had happened, that they were understanding, and that he needs to be more careful next time.
Evan said he and his partner tried snowshoeing the weekend of 6 to 7 January 2024, which was part of a new adventure for them and was surprisingly fun.
Sam said on 10 January 2024 that he had made a meal plan and workout schedule and would do his best to stay on track starting that day, and he shared a photo of a whiteboard covered in writing.
Sam said he planned to make a doctor's appointment soon to ask about a balanced diet plan and advice on low-impact exercises, given his current situation.
Evan listed swimming, yoga and walking as good low-impact exercises, and advised Sam to focus on a balanced diet and low-impact exercises.

Evan said he got a healthy salad with chicken, avocado, tomatoes, corn and cheese from a nearby restaurant, and that beach sunsets are one of his favourite low-impact activities, both good for exercise and calming.
Sam said he watched The Godfather on 9 January 2024, and it motivated him to keep up his routine, while Evan said yoga has helped him with stress and staying flexible, alongside his diet.

On 10 January 2024 Sam said he hoped for positive changes from a healthier diet and yoga, and that he had a recurring dream of flying over skyscrapers, which Evan said he might learn to control with practice.
Sam said on 11 January 2024 that his health had been rough, that his weight feels like it is keeping him from fully living, and that he is trying to stay positive even though it is not easy.
Evan said he had to apologise to his partner for the drunken night, which was pretty embarrassing, and Sam asked how she took the news about the rose bushes.
Evan said his partner was not thrilled but understood it was an accident, and that he promised to be more careful in the future.

Sam said he has not found any low-impact exercises he enjoys, but has been taking car rides lately that help him chill, and he shared a photo of a field with a fence and a dirt road that he snapped in the country the week before 11 January 2024.
Sam said on 11 January 2024 that being in nature really helps him relax and get fresh air away from the city, and that he planned to spend more time in nature himself.
Evan shared a photo of a kayak seen from the front of the boat from a camping trip the previous summer, saying the sunset was amazing and kayaking on the water was truly unforgettable and peaceful.
Evan said nature can be super calming, like pushing a reset button for your mind and body, and that small moments outdoors can make a big impact even when health stuff cramps your style.
Evan shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers in a park, saying it reminded him of last spring when he was feeling a bit down but the vibrant colours brought a smile to his face.
Evan told Sam to keep finding the little things that bring joy, and Sam said he appreciated being reminded that the small things matter because they add up over time.
Evan said on 11 January 2024 that he is always there if Sam needs to chat, and told Sam to look after himself.
On 18 May 2023 Evan said he loved the idea of Sam trying painting, and Sam said he had not tried it yet but was keen to give it a go because it looked like a nice way to chill and get creative.
On 18 May 2023 Sam said he was excited to try new things and that painting should be fun, and he promised Evan he would keep him posted on how it goes.
On 24 May 2023 Sam said he had never been to Jasper but it looked breathtaking, and he asked Evan whether the road trip was relaxing.
On 24 May 2023 Evan told Sam that it is never too late to make positive changes for a healthier lifestyle, and asked whether there was anything he could do to support Sam on the journey.
Sam said on 24 May 2023 that he would give painting a go and let Evan know how it turned out, and that he would not stress about it and would just enjoy it.
On 6 June 2023 Evan said that progress takes time and that he and Sam should keep supporting each other on their health journeys, since making small changes can have a big impact later on.
On 6 June 2023 Sam said he was up for continuing to try and make tiny changes to his health, and thanked Evan for having his back, saying it meant a lot to have him in his corner.
On 27 July 2023 Sam said he had tried flavoured seltzer water before and that it was nice, and he asked Evan for low-calorie snack ideas to go with it.
On 27 July 2023 Sam said Evan's reminder to focus on healthy swaps and small steps was inspiring, and that it helped him focus on progress, not perfection.
On 7 August 2023 Sam said he was sorry to hear Evan was dealing with health issues, and that health problems can make it hard to fully enjoy things, which Sam said from his own experience.
On 7 August 2023 Evan shared a photo of a container of cookies on a counter, joking that it was what life had thrown at him, and said ginger snaps are his weakness.
On 7 August 2023 Sam said that small steps add up and that staying consistent and not giving up matters, and Evan agreed that consistency and perseverance will get them far.
On 13 August 2023 Evan said that surrounding ourselves with people who care is key, and he asked Sam what was written on the note he had shared a photo of.
On 13 August 2023 Evan told Sam to celebrate small wins because every step forward counts, and Sam said celebrating small victories is crucial for keeping him motivated.
On 13 August 2023 Sam said his healthy journey feels endless at times, but he is convinced it will be rewarding in the end, and he wished Evan good luck finding his keys.
On 15 August 2023 Evan said that as a dad it is hard to watch his kid go through an injury like his son's soccer accident, and that he had been looking after his son at home.
On 15 August 2023 Sam told Evan to look after himself too, saying they both have to look after their health, and Evan agreed that taking care of ourselves is a must.
On 15 August 2023 Evan told Sam that it is okay to feel overwhelmed, to keep moving forward slowly and to take small steps, and Sam said he would keep going one step at a time.
On 19 August 2023 Sam said his stir-fry sauce is just his homemade sauce, and he offered to share the recipe with Evan, who said he would love to try it.
On 19 August 2023 Sam asked Evan why he was joining painting classes when he is already good at drawing, and Evan said he started painting after a friend gave him a painting that inspired him.

On 27 August 2023 Sam said that being adaptable and finding other ways to stay active is key when facing an obstacle, and he suggested low-impact exercise or physical therapy to help Evan with his knee.
On 11 September 2023 Evan said making healthier choices had definitely made a difference for him, and that it is amazing how small changes can have such a big impact.
